name: Parmesan-Panko Crusted Pork Cutlets with Squash, Apple & Arugula Salad

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the arugula if it came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
1 small butternut squash
2 Gala apples
1 (142 g) pkg baby arugula

instructions.primary_message: Trim and peel squash; halve lengthwise, scrape out seeds, and medium dice the flesh. Transfer to a baking sheet pan, drizzle with oil, then season with salt and pepper. Stir to coat and spread out in an even layer.
instructions.secondary_message:
extra virgin olive oil
salt
black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, stirring halfway through, until squash is golden brown and fork-tender, 15-20 minutes. Remove from oven and set aside to cool slightly, about 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, finely grate Parmesan. Transfer to a plate along with bread crumbs and spices. Stir to combine the coating and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
57 g Parmesan cheese
2 tsp Italian seasoning
salt
black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place eggs in a medium bowl and beat with a whisk or fork until smooth. Set aside.
Pat pork dry with paper towels and place on a cutting board. Holding a knife parallel to the cutting board, cut the chops in half horizontally to form thin cutlets.
Dip the cutlets into the beaten egg (letting the excess drip off), then into the bread crumb mixture, pressing gently to adhere. Transfer to another plate.
Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Working in batches if necessary, add the breaded cutlets and pan-fry until golden brown and cooked through, about 3 minutes per side. Transfer to a clean plate.
Meanwhile, place oil, vinegar, Dijon, maple syrup, salt, and pepper in a large bowl. Whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
extra virgin olive oil
4 tsp apple cider vinegar
1 tbsp Dijon mustard
1 tbsp pure maple syrup
salt
black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Using a clean cutting board, quarter, core, and medium dice apples. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Add cooled squash and arugula to the bowl. Toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide pork cutlets and salad between plates. Enjoy!
